responsibility: This file is the main operation-expansion engine for the optabs subsystem. It turns abstract unary, binary, comparison, conversion, and miscellaneous operations into concrete RTL by choosing direct instruction patterns, synthesizing operands, attaching REG_EQUAL notes, legitimizing operands against insn constraints, or falling back to libcalls, thereby serving as the central bridge between optab descriptions/queries and the actual emitted RTL sequences used by expr and stmt expansion.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable expansion engine for the optabs stem, turning optab selections into emitted RTL and handling operand preparation, insn generation, and libcall/direct-pattern fallbacks. Unlike gcc/optabs.def, it is not the declarative optab catalog, and unlike gcc/optabs.h, it is not just the public interface and helper type declarations.
